Callout.Name: Weapons Cache - Woodland
Callout.Message: Cache of weapons reported in woodland.
Callout.Advisory: Cache under a tarpaulin, no persons present.

Script.Line: I walk the dog here every day and it has been there three days.
I did not look under it. I am not going to look under it.
There is a padlock and a chain and I am not the one who owns it.

Lines.Approach: It is under a tarpaulin with a padlock on it, about forty metres off the track.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
